title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: provide first-class RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts so engineers can ship retrieval-augmented agents with Redwood quickly. This PR adds opinionated templates for common RAG patterns (single-vectorstore, multi-index routing, streaming responses), a set of language-specific quickstarts (Python/TS) demonstrating tool-calling and structured output, and docs site updates (sidebar + examples). The changes are intended to be drop-in for customers and internal examples for SDKs.

What this PR includes (high level):
- redwood-examples: new rag/templates/*.yaml agent templates covering basic RAG, multi-index routing, and an agent with external tool-calling.
- redwood-examples/quickstarts: Python and TypeScript quickstarts that show how to wire embeddings, vector stores, and tool-calling handlers + tests.
- redwood-docs: docs site guide (docs/guides/rag.md) with walkthrough, configuration reference, and links to quickstarts. Sidebar updated and docs redirects added.
- tests: small smoke tests and example CI job to validate the quickstarts run in CI.

Checklist: [x] Add templates and quickstarts; [x] Docs guide and sidebar update; [x] Basic smoke tests; [x] CI pipeline step added to validate examples; [x] Reviewed and approved by docs and examples owners.

Notes: Initial docs build failed due to a broken relative link in the sidebar; fixed in second commit. Examples are intentionally small (no private keys). Follow-up work (ENG-1322) will add a template for using a managed connector (DB connector) and an extended example for advanced routing.

Related: ENG-1289 (RAG templates initiative), ENG-1322 (connectors follow-up).
